reasoning_content: Great - it starts when running directly! The issue is the env vars not being loaded properly by PM2. Let me update PM2 to load from .env.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Update PM2 env
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete areloria 2>/dev/null")

# Create new PM2 start with env
cmd = """cd /opt/areloria/server && 
SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:8443 
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=test 
node dist/index.js"""

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(f"pm2 start --name areloria -- {cmd} 2>&1")
print("Started:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
